rubric:
Judge whether this 2-second window is usable EEG for decoding, from the raw traces alone.
ACCEPTABLE: every channel shows a plausible, varying EEG-like signal. Small slow drifts and moderate noise are fine.
UNACCEPTABLE: one or more channels are flat or stuck, or large spikes, steps, bursts or movement artifacts dominate the window, or the signal is broken or discontinuous.
If you are not sure, choose the closer label and tick "unsure".
weighting: weight = windows in (stratum, participant) cell / windows sampled from that cell, scaled so each stratum's weights sum to its replay windows; participants with no sampled window in a stratum are represented by the others (see plan)
